summary: This standards-track memo extends SIP so that a call can be refreshed periodically using a re-INVITE or UPDATE request. This lets endpoints and proxies learn whether a session is still alive, so stale state can be cleaned up when a call ended without a proper hangup. It defines new header fields for negotiating the refresh.

eli5.summary: Imagine two friends on a phone call who say hello every so often to check the other is still there. If one stops answering, the call is cleaned up.

questions: how does sip detect dead calls
